name: mia-qwen3.8-flash-next-tensorfold
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next — NVFP4 on TensorFold with MTP drafts (Mia's AI Lab)
author: Mia's AI Lab, on TensorFold

measured.note: the source's numbers (sparkDash, 2026-10-07): 390.1 tok/s at 16 requests; prefill 2,458–2,757 tok/s from 4K to 256K tokens. The INT4-AutoRound checkpoint (QUANT=int4ar) measured 89.3 tok/s at one request.

requirements: scripts/local.sh in the checkout (copy scripts/local.sh.example) with WORKER=<user>@<node B's address>.
Key-based ssh from node A to node B; Docker with the NVIDIA runtime, your user in the docker group, and rsync on both.
~150 GB free disk on each Spark (the checkpoint is ~133 GB; node B needs only the image with WORKER_WEIGHTS=nfs).
~102 GiB MemAvailable on each Spark for the default 1,048,576-token window (~72 GiB at CONTEXT=262144); the kit checks it before it starts.
notes: The first start pulls the engine image on both Sparks, downloads the checkpoint on node A and copies it to node B. Later starts take about two minutes.
KV cache FP8 by default (lossy, ~1.8x the pool); KV_DTYPE=bf16 in scripts/local.sh is exact.
If other work on a Spark takes memory after the start, a long prompt can end both ranks (the kit's issue #7). Keep the Sparks free of other GPU work while the kit serves.
